visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands in a brightly lit indoor room, holding a smartphone as if recording a selfie. She is dressed in a black knit beanie, a white ribbed tank top, and a light blue mid-length apron-style skirt layered over wide-leg blue denim pants. A black shoulder bag with a pink plush charm hangs on her side. To her right, a black clothing rack holds several white and grey garments against a backdrop of neutral-colored curtains. Large white text '3 Ways' is centered at the top, and 'of Denim wide pants' is at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to show 'Look 1'. The woman poses in the same outfit, adjusting her clothing and looking into the lens with a neutral expression. She then leans in very close to the camera, her face filling most of the frame before a quick cut. (3) The scene shifts to 'Look 2'. The woman is now wearing a black off-the-shoulder crop top paired with the same wide-leg denim pants and a black belt. She turns to show a black leather tote bag on her shoulder and glances back at the camera. (4) The scene transitions to 'Look 3'. She has added a black baseball cap and an oversized dark blue t-shirt with a large 'Berry' graphic and strawberry illustrations over her top. She carries a light blue patterned shoulder bag and makes various hand gestures, including a finger-heart and pointing. (5) Finally, she walks toward the camera with a smile, waving her hand. The video concludes with a transition to a solid pink screen.
